tool call error: tool call failed for `orchestrator/orchestrator.tool_execute`

Caused by:
    Mcp error: -32000: exec_on_node refused this command. It only runs curl with an https:// URL and PowerShell that writes literal text (Write-Output, Write-Host, Write-Error, Write-Verbose, Write-Warning, exit N), so it can never launch or drive the operator's shared Chrome/session. Use run_on_node for anything else, including diagnostics such as tasklist, nvidia-smi or Get-CimInstance.
